intro: Designed for organised workspaces, the Storo Quick Cabinet combines secure storage, smooth-glide drawers, and robust steel construction to support efficient, clutter-free document management.

features.title: Advanced anti-tip safety mechanism
features.text: The Storo Quick cabinet is equipped with an intelligent anti-tip system that allows only one drawer to open at a time. This safety feature enhances stability, reducing the risk of toppling even when drawers are fully loaded.

features.title: Smooth-glide drawers for effortless access
features.text: Precision telescopic slides of the cabinet enable each drawer to open and close smoothly with minimal effort. Ergonomic aluminium alloy handles provide a comfortable grip, while the anti-rebound mechanism keeps drawers securely in place when closed.

features.title: Centralised locking system for secure storage
features.text: A built-in cam lock allows all drawers to be secured through a single locking point. This practical feature helps protect important files and documents, offering added peace of mind in shared work environments.

features.title: Organised label holder design
features.text: Integrated aluminium alloy label holders make categorising and locating files simple. This filing cabinet supports quick identification and retrieval of documents, helping maintain an efficient workflow.

features.title: Robust CRCA steel construction
features.text: Built using a durable CRCA steel frame, the filing cabinet is engineered for long-term reliability. Its sturdy structure withstands the demands of everyday office use while maintaining a clean, professional appearance.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Lockable Vertical Filing Cabinet With 2 Drawers For Office In Mild Steel Black
